describe.description: The creature is a single quadrupedal animal shown in right-facing profile against a plain off-white background. Its overall body shape, fur, head, limbs and tail are those of a brown bear, covered in dense shaggy brown fur that is lighter on the muzzle and flanks and darker on the lower legs. Integrated into the fur are several large, smooth, highly glossy dark reddish-brown to black structures that look like the hard exoskeleton of a beetle, including a large curved horn on the forehead, a crested plate over the shoulders, and domed oval plates on the back and outer hindquarter. Two horizontal rows of small oval holes with dark rims are visible in the fur on the mid-flank. The animal stands on four thick legs ending in clawed paws, with a very short furry tail at the rear.

describe.description: The creature is a bulky four-legged mammal covered in shaggy brown fur with the overall body, head, limbs and paws of a brown bear, shown in right-side profile facing right. It has a broad bear head with a lighter tan muzzle, black nose, brown eyes and small rounded furry ears, but a long glossy black curved horn with a small notch rises from the center of its forehead. Glossy dark reddish-brown beetle-like exoskeleton covers parts of the body: a large smooth domed shield over the shoulders and sides of the neck, a long oval ridged shell on the mid-back, and a smaller paired oval ridged shell on the outer right rear thigh, plus thin dark segmented rings around the legs and small dark pointed projections under the throat. Two horizontal rows of small oval dark-rimmed bare holes run along the furry flank on the side. It has four thick furry legs ending in broad clawed paws and a very short furry stub tail at the rear.
